title: Test Infrastructure Hardening — Fix Anti-Patterns + Build Validation Framework
brief: Fix || true assertions, upgrade keyword-only tests to parametric, create 14-stage pipeline validator, cross-material S/F range tables, controller dialect assertion library, 50+ negative input tests, parameter sanity guard. MUST complete before any building.

units.title: Audit and fix ALL || true and keyword-only assertions
units.description: grep for || true in all test files. Replace with parametric checks. Create parseGCode() utility for structured assertion. Upgrade >=50% of .includes() to coordinate/parameter validation.

units.title: Define 14-stage pipeline validation matrix
units.description: Create pipeline-stage-validator.ts with 14 stages, each with typed input/output and validation function. OCR accuracy, feature types, material resolution, machine selection, strategy scoring, tool validation, S/F ranges, toolpath coverage, physics bounds, collision check, G-code syntax, simulation, cycle time, documentation.

units.title: Create cross-material S/F range tables
units.description: Expected Vc/fz/ap ranges per ISO group + 15 specific alloys. Source: Sandvik + Kennametal published data. assertSFInRange() helper function.

relevant_tests: Cross-Material Physics Validation — aluminum faster than Inconel
prerequisite_evidence.note: cam-pipeline-real-parts.test.ts already validates S/F ranges per material. U03 should formalize these into a reusable assertSFInRange() table sourced from Sandvik/Kennametal published data.

exit_conditions: Range table covers 6 ISO groups + 15 alloys
cam-pipeline-real-parts.test.ts cross-material test passes as baseline

units.title: Create controller dialect assertion library
units.description: Per-controller assertion helpers: assertFanucPeckDrill, assertSiemensCycle83, assertHeidenhainCycl200, etc. 6 controller families, 10+ operation types each.

units.title: Create 50+ negative/error input test battery
units.description: Bad materials, negative dimensions, bore>OD conflicts, RPM exceeds max, tool too short, tolerance=0, empty features. Every test verifies graceful failure with actionable error message.
exit_conditions: No crashes on any bad input

units.title: Create parameter sanity guard
units.description: Define physically impossible parameter ranges (feed>5mm/rev, G83 Q>50mm, ap>3xD, etc.). Test that NO pipeline output ever violates these bounds. Catches bugs like 5-axis G83 Q5000.

forge_triple.ownership: DECLARED — BUILT in terminal unit of this milestone
